schema.description: Non-admin evaluation request. Omit target identity fields to select the caller. USER targets accept the caller's canonical ID, known alias IDs, email, or known alias emails; every supplied identity field must identify the caller. AGENT targets require current edit permission and evaluate aggregate agent usage. Spend-client context is always explicit. Shared budgets affect only the overall decision. The authenticated identity is never replaced by the selected target.

target.description: Explicit spend-client context. Omit type and identity fields to evaluate the authenticated user. USER may also omit identity fields to select self.

type.description: USER (the default) or an editable AGENT.

x-enumDescriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.
